I’ll read the handoff and its proof sources, then check which claims are ready for the manuscript. I’ll record the audit, progress, and continuation guidance in the investigation.
The exact cutoff, Mellin pole and tails, and signed high-mode estimate check out. I’m now tracing the inherited residual and Green bounds to verify that they apply on the shorter intervals.

The \(17/81\) window exponent survives the residual audit. I found one scope clarification for integration: the Green bound with an \(O(1/L_U)\) remainder uses the block cutoff \(P_U=\lfloor L_U^2\rfloor\). The residual theorem still holds uniformly over the full stated range of \(P\).

The B10 proof audit is complete. All four checks support the averaged \(c=1\) theorem on windows \(\ell\ge U^{17/81+\rho}\), with the stated remainder and the published and inherited inputs. This was a separate internal audit with contributing agents. The manuscript is unchanged.

For integration, write \(P_U=\lfloor L_U^2\rfloor\) explicitly in the Green transfer and cite the checked Montgomery–Vaughan exponent-pair formulation. The residual theorem still holds uniformly over the full stated range of block-constant \(P\). I’ll integrate B10 into the existing manuscript, keeping the block cutoff explicit in the Green corollary. Then I’ll build the PDF, check the new pages and references, and update the research records.

Section 14 now contains the averaged theorem and the Green corollary with \(P_U=\lfloor L_U^2\rfloor\). The first build exposed one wide equation. I’ve split it across two lines and will check the rebuilt pages and citations.

Integrated the audited B10 result into §14 of the existing manuscript. Theorem 14.1 gives the averaged residual bound for \(\ell\ge U^{17/81+\rho}\) in the stated range. Corollary 14.2 explicitly fixes \(P_U=\lfloor L_U^2\rfloor\) across the outer interval for the Green transfer. The every-center estimate remains open.
